test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All chocolates are balls.

All balls are festivals.

Some festivals are tennis.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All chocolates are festivals.

(II) Some balls are tennis.

options.text: Both conclusion (I) and conclusion (II) do not follow.

solution:
Statements:

All chocolates are balls.

All balls are festivals.

Some festivals are tennis.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a26b4719f4850f6d958227ab524c5cd91f2e404b4498dc3716d69e39216343fc.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All chocolates are festivals. - **True** (because All chocolates are balls and All balls are festivals. So, All chocolates are festivals too)

(II) Some balls are tennis. - **False **(because there is no direct relation between balls and tennis. So, it can be possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion (I) follows".**
